method: Public YouTube channel/watch-page research without YouTube Data API, followed by fresh-browser runtime checks through the existing KantaCue YouTube IFrame controller. No media was downloaded or stored. This correction pass searched multiple medley patterns per provider and treated iframe playback as a hard gate.
publicCatalogPolicy: Only records with trustworthy medley identity evidence and technical-verified-pending-manual-quality-review status are exposed by the public medley loader. Known sections are listed when publicly supported; genuine medleys with unavailable section lists carry explicit unknown-section evidence. Search candidates and runtime failures remain audit-only.

providerCoverage.result: No acceptable one-video medley found in the public channel search used for this audit.
providerCoverage.notes: The visible results were singles, playlists, or unrelated-provider results rather than a clearly documented multi-song karaoke upload. No candidate was fabricated.

providerCoverage.result: Several medleys found, but the strongest tested candidates returned Error 150 in the actual KantaCue player.

providerCoverage.result: Several popular medleys found; distinct genuine medleys that passed the real iframe gate were added with explicit unknown-section metadata when a complete public section list was unavailable.
providerCoverage.notes: All eight investigated KaraokeyTV candidates passed the real KantaCue iframe gate. 9AJt_0ZAtQc, 2J0hjAh06T0, and eFFlXBGs16w have defensible public section evidence. iuDInJI-ZVw, kxZntA43YhE, and nDXOKcknAng are distinct genuine medley uploads and were promoted with sectionStatus=unknown plus explicit evidence; no sections were fabricated. MjJnLgAW1jc was rejected as a near-duplicate of the existing generic OPM medley, and cdfBBrbRUI0 was rejected as a near-duplicate of the existing Carpenters medley.

providerCoverage.result: Public results exposed strong karaoke singles, official playlists, and unrelated-provider medleys, but no sufficiently documented genuine single-video Atomic medley for this phase.
providerCoverage.notes: The official @AtomicKaraoke search exposed individual uploads and official playlists rather than a single-video multi-song medley. fpf7Pzb_kiE (Nothing's Gonna Stop Us Now) and fZyW-T0w0X4 (Beautiful in White) were rejected as single songs; non-Atomic medley results were not treated as Atomic evidence. No Atomic candidate was promoted.

technicalSummary.notes: Runtime verification proves the official iframe path reached onReady/PLAYING, advancing currentTime, and sustained playback in the local test environment. It does not prove audio quality, guide-vocal absence, standard key, or production-domain behavior; those remain manual review items. V2 added three distinct KaraokeyTV medleys with explicit unknown-section evidence and added no Atomic medleys.
